description.subtitle: Nike Sports Sunglasses - blue, purple
description.intro: Nike Maverick Free sunglasses have been designed with a functional style that provides safety and comfort. Ideal for sports activities and day-to-day, they offer effective sun protection and a stable fit.
key_benefits: Advanced solar protection: UV400 filter and category 3 for a total defense against radiation and glare.
Durabilidad y ligereza: Montura de policarbonato resistente que garantiza comodidad en su uso.
Clarity and safety: Polycarbonate lenses that offer sharp vision and protection against impacts.
Perfect fit: Flexible pads that provide support and stability.
Transport protection: Includes rigid case to keep them safe and secure.
